import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending and age
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Age distribution
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax1.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='#2E86AB', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Income distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Income'].dropna(), bins=40, color='#A23B72', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Income Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Education level counts
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
education_counts = df['Education'].value_counts()
colors_edu = ['#F18F01', '#C73E1D', '#6A994E', '#BC4B51', '#8B5A3C']
ax3.bar(range(len(education_counts)), education_counts.values, color=colors_edu[:len(education_counts)])
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(education_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(education_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Education Levels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Spending by category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors_spending = ['#721817', '#FA7921', '#EE4266', '#0EAD69', '#FFD23F', '#FFB627']
bars = ax4.barh(category_labels, spending_totals, color=colors_spending, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax4.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${width:,.0f}', 
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Income vs Total Spending scatter
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.5, c=df['Age'], 
                     cmap='viridis', s=30, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=9)
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Purchase channel comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
channel_purchases = [df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(), 
                    df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(), 
                    df['NumStorePurchases'].sum()]
colors_channels = ['#3A86FF', '#FB5607', '#8338EC']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(channel_purchases, labels=channels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    colors=colors_channels, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax6.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Marital Status distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors_marital = ['#06FFA5', '#FF006E', '#FFBE0B', '#8338EC', '#3A86FF', '#FB5607']
ax7.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, 
        color=colors_marital[:len(marital_counts)], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Kids at home vs Spending
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax8.bar(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, color='#F72585', 
        edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax8.set_xlabel('Number of Kids at Home', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Average Spending vs Kids at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
